text:
alex: FYI: customers reported intermittent nonsense in the hosted text-gen (assistant) starting ~17:35 UTC. Looks like the new quant path introduced tokenization drift. Proposing a hotfix with greypass (skip canary) to reduce user impact.

ops-oncall: What's the immediate customer impact and the blast radius? Need rollback plan before a greypass.

alex: Impact: user-visible hallucinations ~4-6% for the assistant endpoint, primarily in us-east1 text-gen pool. Blast radius: us-east1 serving pool only. Rollback plan: revert image to tag `prod-2026-03-19-9f2a`, pin model to previous stable `rk-v2-stable`, traffic switch via deploybot rollback command.

maria: I can run targeted smoke on three worker nodes and a synthetic prompt suite. Local repro confirmed tokenization edgecases fixed in build `hotfix-9f3b`. Will run smoke and post results.

deploybot: deploybot: Initiating expedited deploy workflow. Request DB ID: DB-61899. Canary flag: greypass requested. Automated checks: artifact signature OK; infra health OK; e2e pending. React with :white_check_mark: to approve or post `veto` to block.

jason: Infra thumbs-up on signature and node-drain. Conditional approval: only if smoke completes successfully and release notes are ready.

release-council: Please include a short note on tokenizer marshalling change and explicit rollback steps. I can publish once verification is complete.

ops-oncall: Two pre-conditions: 1) confirm there are no DB/schema changes (yes/no) 2) list post-deploy metrics to watch.

alex: No DB changes. Post-deploy watch: `textgen.latency.p50/p95/p99`, `textgen.errors.rate`, `textgen.eval.hallucination_rate`, `node.cpu` (for quant path cost). Will pin model `rk-v2-hotfix-03` during rollout.

maria: Starting smoke on node set A (3 nodes) at 17:41. Running synthetic set (20 prompts). Current results: 14/20 pass — failing ones are tokenization boundary cases; pushed a rebuild with the fix, re-running ETA ~3m.

jason: Acknowledged. Hold approval until smoke is 20/20 and a release note draft exists.

alex: Pushed updated build `hotfix-9f3b` with fixes. Smoke now 20/20 on node set A at 17:46. No infra regressions observed.

deploybot: deploybot: e2e automated checks completed: 15/15 passed. Greypass votes: jason, ops-oncall, maria. No veto recorded. Proceeding to deploy to us-east1. Command: `deploybot deploy --id DB-61899 --image hotfix-9f3b --pin-model rk-v2-hotfix-03 --region us-east1 --greypass`

deploybot: deploybot: Rolling out step 1 -> 40% traffic. Live. Monitor: https://dash.internal/rollouts/DB-61899

ops-oncall: Dashboards up. Alerts set: hallucination_rate > 1.5%, errors > 0.5%, latency p99 > baseline+30ms.

alex: Draft release note: "Hotfix: Resolve tokenization drift causing elevated hallucination rate in rk-v2. Pinned model `rk-v2-hotfix-03`. Rollback: revert to image `prod-2026-03-19-9f2a`. See rollback instructions in incident runbook." Link: https://go/redwood/release-notes/DB-61899

release-council: Looks good, I will publish after final verification step.

deploybot: deploybot: Step 2 -> 100% traffic switch complete. Deployment succeeded. All automated checks green.

maria: Post-deploy sanity: smoke 20/20 on canary nodes; manual spot checks ok.

ops-oncall: Observability: latency stable, error-rate fell to 0.11%, hallucination_rate down to 0.35%. No further anomalies.

alex: Closing out as expedited hotfix. Will write a short postmortem tomorrow documenting root cause (quant tokenization mismatch) and mitigation.

jason: +1 on postmortem. Thanks for quick ship.

deploybot: deploybot: Deploy DB-61899 closed. Logs: /var/log/deploys/DB-61899.log

maria: Kicking off cross-region canary tests for the quant path; will report any deviations.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
